nodes.title: OptoLink: Breaking Memory Bandwidth Bottlenecks in FHE Accelerators with Photonic Interconnects
nodes.venue: ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems
nodes.venue_abbr: ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems
nodes.summary: 论文提出芯粒级光互连架构 OptoLink，利用波分复用和空分复用缓解全同态加密加速器的存储带宽与片外通信瓶颈，并支持广播和组播。摘要报告设计带宽最高为1.6 TB/s，覆盖128个光通道。基于扩展的FHE仿真框架，CKKS自举吞吐量在HEAX上最高提升11倍，在F1和ARK上最高提升1.6倍。
